name: search_wiki
description: BM25 keyword search for the wiki. Use plain words separated by spaces with no punctuation (queries like `path:Wiki%20Project` do not work). Returns the top-ranked matches with `path`, `title`, and a short `snippet`. Snippets are often NOT enough context to answer detailed questions or to edit a doc. After identifying the right document(s), call `read_page(path)` to get the full body.

query.description: Search query. Be specific — e.g. "flask 3.0 streaming response keep-alive" is preferable to "flask streaming".
